transparency.title: Agent Stream & Transparency
transparency.subtitle: Every game on gamedev.pl is open-source, maintained by coding agents, and safely isolated.
transparency.activity1: Copilot Agent validated PR for Sky Dodge Deluxe — 100% tests passing
transparency.activity2: New spec submission received for Coin Catcher v2
transparency.activity3: Static game bundle published to gamedev.pl catalog
transparency.securityBody: Generated code is untrusted and executes inside an isolated iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts" and no allow-same-origin. Zero cookie access, zero credential leakage.
transparency.openSourceBody: All games live in our public games repository maintained by autonomous AI coding agents.

contentRejected.profanity: That includes language we can't publish. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.adult: That describes adult content, which we can't generate. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.violence: That describes graphic violence or self-harm, which we can't generate. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.pii: That looks like it contains personal contact details (email, phone, address) — please remove them and try again.
contentRejected.injection: That looks like it's trying to instruct the build agent rather than describe a game. Please rephrase and try again.
contentRejected.other: We can't accept that as written. Please rephrase and try again.
